name: Anchor-It
description: Wire suspension for concrete ceilings. Vibration resistant and tamper-proof one-piece nail anchor. Spring-type compression force — no clawback required.

name: Con-Lock
description: Wire suspension for concrete ceilings. BS8539 compliant M6 hammer fixing — no drilling required. ETA approved, shallow embedment into cracked and non-cracked concrete.

name: Dec-Lock
description: Wire suspension for concrete over rib-deck ceilings. Non-destructive deck wedge anchor fits into the profile channels of the rib-deck — no drilling into concrete.

name: Duct-Lock
description: Wire suspension system for rectangular ductwork. Eliminates the need for a bearer underneath the duct. Uses S-system wire rope with 45 kg SWL.

name: Fire Strut-Lock
description: Stainless steel Strut-Lock for fire-rated applications. 90 kg SWL in ambient conditions. For HVAC ductwork, signage and installations above fire escape routes.

name: G-BRACKET
description: Heavy-duty bracket system for direct structural fixing. Designed for high-load applications where a rigid anchor point is required.

name: Knock-It
description: Wire suspension for purlin steelwork (cold rolled steel) with a vertical flange. Knock-on purlin clip — no tools required. Available for 1-5 mm and 5-7 mm purlin thickness.

name: Loop-It
description: Wire rope suspension using a choke knot wrap-around fix. Suspends from purlins, eye bolts or brackets from a variety of base materials. No tools required.

name: Luma-Lock
description: Toggle-based V-hanger for cable tray. Fitted at floor level then offered up to vertical wire support. Spans 50–600 mm. Reduces material on long containment runs.

name: Rize
description: Wire rope on reels with Zip-Clip locking devices. Custom-fit drop lengths on-site for lightweight or heavy-duty installations. G, S, Y, SY and YY systems available.

name: Shot-Lock
description: Wire suspension fixed using Powder Actuated Tools (PAT). Shot-fire bracket termination for fast fixing to steel or concrete. Lightweight applications only.

name: Snap-It
description: Wire suspension with carabiner termination for quick installation or removal. Carabiner couples with additional fixings for multiple ceiling types.

name: SPAN-KIT
description: Pre-assembled catenary spanning kit. Suspends services where no overhead fixing points are available. Ready to install from the box — no measuring or cutting required.

name: Span-Lock and Zip-Grip
description: Catenary system for traversing between two fixed anchor points with vertical suspension drops. For applications where no overhead fixing is available. Used with Zip-Grip tensioner.

name: Strut-Lock
description: M8 and M10 devices for supporting HVAC and M&E services from profile channel hung from a wire suspension. Single and multi-tier trapeze bracket applications.

name: Thread-It
description: Wire suspension with male threaded eyebolt (M6 or M8). Couples with female threaded connections or through-holes. Connects to multiple base material types.

name: Toggle-It
description: Wire suspension with toggle termination. Designed for thin tin roofs, sheet metal and void spaces. Toggle spans through-holes up to 12 mm diameter.

name: Try-Lock
description: Single-point V-hanger suspension using snap gate carabiners. Reduces material use on long cable tray and basket runs. Spans 50–400 mm as standard.

name: Uni-Lock
description: 90-degree bracket suspension for timber, concrete, plasterboard or steel. Factory-swaged bracket allows fixing to multiple base materials with a standard fastener.

name: Y-It
description: Wire rope suspension solution with Y-shaped termination for wide-span applications. Designed for use with the Y-system wire rope at 120 kg SWL.

name: ZC150SS
description: Fire-tested stainless steel wire suspension system. Maintains structural integrity at elevated temperatures. For safety-critical applications above fire escape routes.

name: Zip-Lock
description: Friction-free eyelet choke knot suspension. Wrap-around fix to purlins or coupled with eye bolts or brackets. Available in G, S and Y systems.

name: Zip-Rod
description: Wire rope suspension with threaded rod termination. Allows coupling directly to threaded inserts or female fixings. Direct replacement for traditional threaded rod drops.

name: ZIP-STRUT
description: Wire rope-suspended support channel system replacing traditional threaded rod and strut. Faster installation, lighter weight, stronger performance for M&E applications.
